sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN strpos((e.properties ->> $3::text), $4::text) > 0 END), false) AND COALESCE((e.properties @> $5::jsonb), false) AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN (e.properties ->> $3::text) = ANY($6::text[]) END), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN (e.properties ->> $3::text) <> $7::text END), false) AND COALESCE((NOT (jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN (e.properties ->> $3::text) <> ALL($8::text[]) END), false) AND COALESCE((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof((e.properties -> $3::text)) = 'string' THEN left((e.properties ->> $3::text), char_length($9::text)) = $9::text END), false)))
